title: Fake Things
description: Add fake items and blocks into the Minecraft.
body:
该模组添加了可以伪装成其他物品或方块的 Meme 类型的物品和方块，已在 GitHub 开源。

你可以使用指令 /give-fake <item> (count) (damage) (player(s)) 或  /give <player(s)> <item>{fake_item:<item>} (count) 来生成伪装成指定物品的物品。
伪装成指定物品的假物品最大耐久值和物品堆叠上限，攻击动画等属性皆与伪装的物品相同，但是假物品不可使用，其实际攻击伤害为 0，挖掘速度为 1.0，而非物品提示框上所显示的数值。
当假物品被穿戴在玩家身上时，也并不会提供实际盔甲值，盔甲韧性等属性。
当假物品被伪装的物品为方块时，被放置的方块将自动变成假方块，假方块无掉落物，其硬度与 石头 相同。
提示：
1. 假物品并不会掉耐久，你可以通过这个方法来分辨指定物品是否为假物品；
2. 假方块将会在游戏存档被关闭时移除；
3. 图片内展示的物品皆为假物品.

This mod adds meme-type items and blocks that can be disguised as other items or blocks and has been open-sourced on GitHub.

You can use the commands /give fake <item> (count) (damage) (player(s)) or /give <player(s)> <item>{fake_item:<item>} (count) Generate items that disguise themselves as the specified items.
The maximum durability value, item stacking limit, attack animation and other attributes of the fake item disguised as the designated item are all the same as those of the disguised item. However, the fake item cannot be used. Its actual attack damage is 0 and the digging speed is 1.0, rather than the values displayed on the item prompt box.
When fake items are worn by players, they do not provide actual armor values, armor resilience and other attributes.
When the fake item is disguised as a block, the placed block will automatically become a fake block. The fake block has no dropped items and its hardness is the same as that of a stone.
Hint
1. Fake items do not lose durability. You can use this way to distinguish whether a specified item is a fake one.
2. False blocks will be removed when the game save is closed.
3. All the items shown in the gallery are fake.

I can't upload the fake things 1.2 version. You can download this version on the Github Releases.
